demo.title: ⚡ Quick Assistants
demo.leadBefore: The voice assistant and AI Agent are already componentized and can be invoked as popups on any page. The
demo.leadAfter: in the bottom-right corner is freely draggable; click it to expand the menu, toggle both assistants, or jump straight to a given page.
demo.analyzeButtons: Analyze which buttons the current page has

method.m1Desc: After mounting <Assistants /> in the Layout, any page component can read and control the assistant panels through the Hook.
method.m2Title: Imperative API (usable from any JS / Vue page)
method.m2Desc: No React context required; callable directly from Vue SFCs, vanilla JS, or the browser console.
method.m3Desc: Vue, Angular pages, or iframes can all wake the assistants with this event, consistent with the existing app:navigate usage in the project.
method.m4Title: Embedded component (independently controlled outside the assistant hub)
method.m4Desc: The voice assistant panel is itself an ordinary controlled component and can also be used alone in a single page with its own state.
